    Theorem 2.7: the extension criterion #

    Let Φ : D_fin → mod A be a faithful representation embedding with retractions on C_fin whose kernels satisfy a common nilpotence bound. Then its colimit extension F is a representation embedding on D, commutes with direct sums and filtered colimits, preserves infinite dimension, and has retractions on C with the same bound.

    The new point is reflection of isomorphism classes on all of D. Write T ≅ T₀ ⊕ S₋^(I) with T₀ ∈ C by (2.2). An isomorphism F(T) ≅ F(U) has an invertible block F(T₀) → F(U₀) by (2.5), Lemma 2.6 and the no-summand lemma, and then an invertible Schur complement F(S₋^(I)) ≅ F(S₋^(J)), whence |I| = |J|.
